quality_effect: Keep HMLR INSPIRE identity, monthly freshness and CRS reprojection uncertainty explicit before spatial binding.
verified_facts: INSPIRE Index Polygons show the position and indicative extent of registered freehold property.
Each polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title.
A polygon on a local-authority boundary may appear in both authority files.
The INSPIRE dataset updates on the first Sunday of each month.
Each release represents data from the previous month.
HMLR polygon geometry is captured against British National Grid.
British National Grid is EPSG:27700 in the HMLR technical guidance.
Web-map use requires reprojection to another CRS such as EPSG:3857.
HMLR warns that BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection calculations may shift some features by up to 15m.
Duplicate authority-file appearances must be deduplicated by INSPIRE identity rather than treated as two parcels.
Indicative INSPIRE geometry cannot by itself promote a parcel to exact-boundary height measurement.
